title: Record that the tail intake packet leaves the owner unproved
body:
## Summary
- Packet 2089 archives the nine tail files. Its decision is empty.
- The stored pull-request body says global owner/host scheduling for the source reads remains unproved. The packet does not mention event 5759.
- No selected frontier change and no new exponent. This reading does not build an owner map.
